title: Gunsen Prime
extract:
Gunsen Prime is the Primed counterpart of the  Gunsen warfan, acting as a direct upgrade. Gunsen Prime was released alongside  Wisp Prime and  Fulmin Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Slicing Feathers and  Votive Onslaught stance.

Acquisition

Notes
Warfan slams hit twice.
The second hit of a heavy slam will use the stats of a normal slam.

Trivia
The Gunsen (軍扇) is a type of Japanese war fan used by the common soldiery for cooling themselves in hot weather. Unlike other types of war fans, the Gunsen were used more for their intended utility (fanning oneself) than for battle.
The Gunsen Prime was the first Warfan type melee weapon to be Primed.
The Gunsen Prime, alongside  Afuris Prime,  Akbolto Prime,  Aksomati Prime,  Akstiletto Prime,  Ballistica Prime,  Cernos Prime, Daikyu Prime,  Dual Kamas Prime,  Dual Keres Prime,  Fang Prime,  Paris Prime and  Zhuge Prime are the only Prime weapons that do not require Orokin Cells as crafting ingredients.
